name: Convert thalamic, hippocampal and amygdala segmentation into parcellation
summary: Converts FreeSurfer thalamic nuclei and hippocampal/amygdala segmentations into two volumetric parcellations in T1 space, each with a label.json.
description: Converts the thalamic nuclei and the left/right hippoAmygLabels files with mri_convert (right-hemisphere hippocampal labels offset by 100), resamples them to the T1 grid with mri_vol2vol (nearest neighbour), and renumbers voxel values with bundled label tables. Run both FreeSurfer thalamic nuclei and hippocampal subfield segmentations first.

inputs.description: FreeSurfer subject directory (FreeSurfer 7) containing the thalamic nuclei and hippocampal/amygdala segmentation files in mri/.
T1-weighted image that defines the output space and voxel grid.
inputs.requirements: Must be in the same space as the FreeSurfer input (resampled with --regheader).

outputs.description: Hippocampal subfield and amygdala nuclei parcellation (parc.nii.gz) on the T1 grid with label.json.
Thalamic nuclei parcellation (parc.nii.gz) on the T1 grid with label.json.

parameters.description: Which FreeSurfer segmentation to convert: thal (thalamic nuclei), hippamyg (hippocampal subfields and amygdala nuclei) or both. Fixed for this App.
Which hippocampal/amygdala segmentation level to use (FreeSurfer hippoAmygLabels files): default (full detail), CA, FS60 or HBT. Ignored for thalamic nuclei.
